title: KVarN: Variance-Normalized KV-Cache Quantization Mitigates Error Accumulation in Reasoning Tasks
claim: Autoregressive decode errors in quantized KV caches accumulate differently from prefill-style tests; token-scale errors are a key culprit; Hadamard rotation plus dual-axis variance normalization helps at 2-bit.
cloudtainer_test: Pseudo-decode tiny-transformer/tensor-only probe: measure scale error, top-error outliers, and accuracy collapse vs decode length under fp32/int4/int2 variants.

title: Beyond Speedup -- Utilizing KV Cache for Sampling and Reasoning
claim: KV caches can be reused as lightweight contextual representations for downstream sampling/reasoning decisions such as chain-of-embedding and fast/slow thinking switching.
cloudtainer_test: Treat KV tensors from a tiny model as embeddings; test whether cache-derived features predict answer correctness, uncertainty, or need-more-steps on generated tasks.

title: Neural Garbage Collection: Learning to Forget while Learning to Reason
claim: A model can learn cache eviction decisions as part of reasoning from outcome reward, rather than relying on hand-designed token importance proxies.
cloudtainer_test: Mini RL/bandit forgetting loop on generated arithmetic or symbolic tasks: choose which scratch/KV slots to drop, reward final accuracy plus memory budget.

title: Self-Pruned Key-Value Attention
claim: Predict future KV utility to shrink the long-term cache during generation.
cloudtainer_test: Supervised utility predictor from synthetic traces: can early token features predict later attention/retrieval utility better than attention mass alone?

title: Echo: KV-Cache-Free Associative Recall with Spectral Koopman Operators
claim: Spectral Koopman Attention stores key/value history in constant-memory sufficient statistics and improves associative recall where pure SSMs hit a memory cliff.
cloudtainer_test: Implement the smallest kernel-ridge/spectral-memory analog and benchmark against attention, additive linear attention, and delta-rule memory on multi-query associative recall.

title: Kaczmarz Linear Attention
claim: A Kaczmarz/iterative-solver view can improve linear attention retrieval and multi-query associative recall over Gated DeltaNet baselines.
cloudtainer_test: Toy row-projection memory update: compare iterative correction vs additive/delta writes under key collisions and increasing pair count.

title: Variational Linear Attention: Stable Associative Memory for Long-Context Transformers
claim: Frames linear attention memory update as online regularized least-squares with adaptive penalty, stabilizing state norm and associative retrieval.
cloudtainer_test: Implement the normalized write + Sherman-Morrison update in small dimensional settings; chart capacity boundary vs head dimension.

title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
claim: Separating erase and write gates in delta-rule linear attention improves memory editing over a single shared scalar gate.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny delta-rule fast-weight arena with separate erase/write gates: does disentangling erase/write reduce interference in repeated-key updates?

title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
claim: Kimi Delta Attention extends Gated DeltaNet with finer-grained gating and hybridizes with latent attention for reduced KV cache and long-context throughput.
cloudtainer_test: Abstract the gate granularity knob only; compare scalar, channel-wise, and low-rank gates on controlled recall/update tasks.

title: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles
claim: Improved SSM recurrence, complex-valued updates, and MIMO formulation improve retrieval/state tracking without Transformer-style cache growth.
cloudtainer_test: Not reproduce full Mamba; test complex vs real recurrent state in a generated state-tracking microbench.

title: Dynamic Short Convolutions Improve Transformers
claim: Input-dependent short convolutions applied to Q/K/V or linear layers improve associative recall and scaling-law efficiency over static convolutions or plain Transformers.
cloudtainer_test: Add tiny dynamic local filters before Q/K/V in a small attention model; test if local context preconditioning helps associative recall at small scale.

title: Forget Attention: Importance-Aware Attention Is All You Need
claim: Add an SSM-derived importance term directly into softmax attention scores, keeping stock SDPA and avoiding separate recurrent compartments.
cloudtainer_test: Score-level fusion toy: add a learned recurrent importance scalar/vector to attention logits; test if needle retrieval converges faster.

title: Multi-Mixer Models: Flexible Sequence Modeling with Shared Representations
claim: A model can switch across the sequence between attention and recurrent mixers while sharing most parameters, using attention only on a small fraction of tokens for retrieval-heavy segments.
cloudtainer_test: Synthetic router: decide per segment whether to use attention or cheap recurrence; train/evaluate routing masks under memory and accuracy budgets.

title: Expressivity-Efficiency Tradeoffs for Hybrid Sequence Models
claim: Hybrid models can solve selective copying and associative recall with smaller size/working memory than pure Transformers or pure SSMs in certain regimes.
cloudtainer_test: Reproduce tiny separations: pure attention vs pure recurrence vs hybrid on selective copying and associative recall at matched working-memory budgets.

title: Compressed Convolutional Attention: Efficient Attention in a Compressed Latent Space
claim: Down-project Q/K/V and perform attention in a shared latent space to reduce parameters, KV cache, and FLOPs together.
cloudtainer_test: Latent attention zoo: MHA/GQA/MLA/CCA variants at equal latent dimension and memory bytes on recall and induction tasks.

title: Towards Economical Inference: Enabling Multi-Head Latent Attention in Any Transformer-based LLMs
claim: Convert attention to latent KV form with low-rank approximations and partial positional handling, reducing KV cache in existing models.
cloudtainer_test: Train-from-scratch tiny MLA instead of conversion; isolate how latent rank affects content-addressed recall.

title: CoPE: Clipped RoPE as A Scalable Free Lunch for Long Context LLMs
claim: Soft clipping low-frequency RoPE components can improve long-context length generalization and avoid hard-clipping artifacts.
cloudtainer_test: RoPE vs hard clip vs soft clip on train-short/eval-long key-value retrieval, induction, and formal-language tasks.

title: Long-Context Generalization with Sparse Attention
claim: Softmax attention may disperse over irrelevant tokens as length grows; sparse entmax variants can assign exact zeros and improve fixed-pattern long-context generalization.
cloudtainer_test: Softmax vs entmax/sparsemax/top-k on increasing distractor length; measure focus collapse and wrong-needle rate.

title: Discovering Interpretable Algorithms by Decompiling Transformers to RASP
claim: Small length-generalizing Transformers trained on algorithmic/formal tasks can sometimes be reparameterized and reduced to simple RASP programs via causal interventions.
cloudtainer_test: Train tiny models on sort/select/parity/bracket tasks; attempt hand-lite decompilation by tracing attention masks, MLP thresholds, and ablation sufficiency.

title: Length Generalization Bounds for Transformers
claim: Computable length-generalization bounds are impossible for broad C-RASP/Transformer classes, but computable exponential bounds exist for a positive/fixed-precision fragment.
cloudtainer_test: Use as caution: never infer true length-generalization from short sweeps; include adversarial length sweeps and exact finite automata baselines.

title: Softmax Transformers are Turing-Complete
claim: Length-generalizable softmax chain-of-thought Transformers can be Turing-complete under certain formal constructions.
cloudtainer_test: Not a reproduction target; use to motivate tiny computational-language tasks and careful distinction between expressivity and trainability.

title: Looped Transformers for Length Generalization
claim: Looping a Transformer with adaptive steps can improve length generalization on tasks with known iterative RASP-like solutions.
cloudtainer_test: Compare fixed-depth vs looped tiny models on addition/parity/pointer-chasing; track step budget vs extrapolation.

title: Chain-of-Thought and Compressed Looped Transformers
claim: Compressed recurrent loops expose a memory-budget view of chain-of-thought and associative recall; performance depends on whether persistent-state budget matches task demand.
cloudtainer_test: Compressed-loop arena: hidden-state-only loops vs full sequence-state loops vs explicit scratchpad tokens.

title: Attractor Geometry of Transformer Memory: From Conflict Arbitration to Confident Hallucination
claim: Facts in hidden-state space behave like attractor basins; geometric margin can separate correct recall from hallucination better than output entropy in their setting.
cloudtainer_test: Create synthetic fact-memory task with installed facts and absent facts; compare output entropy, nearest-basin distance, and hidden-state margins.

title: Context-Gated Associative Retrieval: From Theory to Transformers
claim: External context can reshape associative-memory energy landscapes, improving retrieval through context-gated separation and sparsity.
cloudtainer_test: Hopfield toy: compare ungated vs context-gated memory under ambiguous keys and category-conditioned recall.

title: HoReN: Normalized Hopfield Retrieval for Large-Scale Sequential Model Editing
claim: A codebook/Hopfield retrieval wrapper around a layer can support many sequential edits with paraphrase robustness and less degradation.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny parameter-preserving edit memory: store thousands of synthetic key edits, test interference/paraphrase/no-op stability.

title: GradMem: Learning to Write Context into Memory with Test-Time Gradient Descent
claim: Optimize a small set of prefix memory tokens at test time with a self-supervised reconstruction loss; gradient writing can store more information than forward-only memory writers.
cloudtainer_test: Write/read key-value task: compare learned forward writer, gradient-written tokens, recurrent memory, and full-context oracle at fixed memory slots.

title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
claim: Attention acts as short-term memory; a neural long-term memory module updates at test time and can improve long-context/needle tasks in reported experiments.
cloudtainer_test: Surprise-gated memory micro-version: compare attention-only, recurrent memory, and surprise-updated memory on associative recall with changing facts.

title: ATLAS: Learning to Optimally Memorize the Context at Test Time
claim: Optimizes memory using current and past tokens to address limited capacity, online-only updates, and weak memory management in recurrent memory models.
cloudtainer_test: Batch/past-token memory optimization vs single-token online update on sequences with later corrections and multi-hop retrieval.

title: Titans Revisited: A Lightweight Reimplementation and Critical Analysis of a Test-Time Memory Model
claim: Lightweight reimplementation finds Titans does not always beat baselines, while neural memory tends to help over attention-only; highlights reproducibility ambiguities.
cloudtainer_test: Every Titans-like cell must include strong baselines and ablations; treat original claims as hypotheses, not facts.

claim: Replaces growing KV cache with fixed-size learned memory using two-pass recurrent compression, online gradient descent, and a forget gate.
cloudtainer_test: Fixed-slot KV memory with learned write/forget gate; compare to ring buffer, reservoir, and top-attention eviction.

claim: Block-recurrent KVM attention can support fixed or growable compressed state, subquadratic prefill, and sublinear state growth.

cloudtainer_test: Tiny fast-weight adapter updates over a stream; compare to explicit memory slots on held-out recall queries.

title: Test-Time Training Done Right
claim: Large-chunk test-time training improves hardware utilization and fast-weight capacity compared with tiny online updates.
cloudtainer_test: Chunk-size sweep for fast-weight updates in CPU setting; measure capacity vs cost for generated memory tasks.

title: Mela: Test-Time Memory Consolidation based on Transformation Hypothesis
claim: Hierarchical memory with low-frequency gist and high-frequency episodic submodules consolidates memory online at test time.
cloudtainer_test: Two-rate memory toy: separate slow gist slots and fast episodic slots; test corrections, abstraction, and distractor resistance.

title: Gated Differentiable Working Memory for Long-Context Test-Time Adaptation
claim: A write controller gates which parts of context receive gradient-step consolidation under limited compute, based on contextual utility.
cloudtainer_test: Budgeted gradient allocation: can a tiny controller choose which chunks deserve memory-write steps?

title: Absorber LLM: Harnessing Causal Synchronization for Test-Time Training
claim: Synchronize an adapted contextless model with a full-context model to absorb history into parameters while preserving causal effects.
cloudtainer_test: Teacher-full-context vs student-absorbed-memory toy; match future logits after streaming context is removed.

title: MemCoT: Test-Time Scaling through Memory-Driven Chain-of-Thought

title: LongFlow: Efficient KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Models

cloudtainer_test: Current-query-only importance estimator vs rolling history estimator in long generated traces.

title: Cache What Lasts: Token Retention for Memory-Bounded KV Cache in LLMs
claim: A learned retention gate trained by distillation plus capacity loss can outperform heuristic eviction in low-memory regimes.
cloudtainer_test: Train a small retention gate from an oracle full-attention model on synthetic tasks; test transfer to longer contexts.

title: LazyEviction: Lagged KV Eviction with Attention Pattern Observation for Efficient Long Reasoning
claim: Token importance can recur after many steps; lagged eviction protects periodically critical tokens that simple score eviction would drop.
cloudtainer_test: Construct periodic-use tokens and delayed recurrence; measure when lagged eviction beats greedy eviction.

title: SkipKV: Selective Skipping of KV Generation and Storage for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
claim: Coarse sentence-level skipping/removal may preserve semantic coherence better than unstable token-wise eviction in reasoning traces.
cloudtainer_test: Segment-level vs token-level compression on generated structured explanations; track loop/revalidation behavior.

title: Which Heads Matter for Reasoning? RL-Guided KV Cache Compression
claim: Only some attention heads are essential for reasoning consistency; RL can probe and allocate cache to reasoning-critical heads.
cloudtainer_test: Head-drop ablations in tiny multi-head model; learn a head budget policy from final-task reward.

title: Adaptive KV-Cache Quantization for Lightweight On-Device LLMs
claim: A lightweight controller can assign variable KV precision from token-level features instead of using one fixed bitwidth.
cloudtainer_test: Feature-based bit controller: allocate fp16/int8/int4/int2 to synthetic cache tokens, optimize accuracy-memory Pareto.

title: Mixed-Dimension Budget Allocation for Efficient KV Cache Compression
claim: Token eviction is a coarse zero/full-dimensional allocation; mixed-dimensional allocation preserves partial information per token under budget.
cloudtainer_test: Dimension dropout per token: test whether keeping a few dimensions from many tokens beats keeping full vectors for fewer tokens.

cloudtainer_test: Toy compare scalar quantization vs grouped-coordinate quantization under attention-inner-product preservation.

cloudtainer_test: Estimate covariance from calibration traces; compare random/Hadamard/PCA/covariance rotations under 2-bit cache.

cloudtainer_test: Local-linear estimator attention toy: does covariance probing help on noisy key-value retrieval?

title: Mixture of Chapters: Scaling Learnt Memory in Transformers
claim: Learned sparse memory banks partitioned into routed chapters can increase explicit associative memory capacity and improve retention under continued training.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny routed memory-bank model: do chapter routers specialize on synthetic fact families and resist forgetting?

title: STEM: Scaling Transformers with Embedding Modules
claim: Token-indexed sparse embedding modules increase parametric capacity, interpretability, and long-context capacity scaling without proportional compute.
cloudtainer_test: Token-indexed memory table in a tiny decoder/sequence model; test editable facts and retrieval interference.

title: Chess-World-Model: A 10M-Game Benchmark for Exact State Tracking from Chess Move Sequences
claim: Exact state tracking from legal move sequences exposes failures hidden by scale; recurrent models outperform Transformers at small parameter sizes in reported chess-state tests.

claim: In Needleman-Wunsch matrix generation, more data past a threshold can slow validation convergence even while fitting accelerates, separating memorization and rule-learning dynamics.
cloudtainer_test: Structured-output matrix tasks at varied data sizes; look for non-monotonic data-size sweet spots on CPU.

title: The Geometric Inductive Bias of Grokking
claim: Architectural topology such as spherical normalization and uniform attention ablation can bypass grokking delays on modular addition in specific symmetry-aligned settings.

claim: In ReLU MLP modular arithmetic, algorithmic structure may be present before grokking and later sharpen into generalization.
cloudtainer_test: Probe early-trained models for Fourier/square-wave structure before validation accuracy rises.

claim: Controlled small-transformer experiments can probe how models associate information across modalities from in-context examples.

claim: Looping may synergize with linear/sparse attention by refining memory iteratively and expanding effective receptive field without full quadratic attention.

claim: Adaptive pruning has to be cheap enough for real prefill/decode use; KVzap approximates KVzip-style pruning with a better speed/accuracy tradeoff.
cloudtainer_test: Use synthetic cache reconstruction and decode probes to test whether low-cost proxy scores approximate expensive leave-one-out/reconstruction scores.

cloudtainer_test: In pseudo-decode, assign different bit-widths by layer/time and ask whether progressive schedules beat fixed precision under same average bits.

claim: Attention sink tokens interact with KV quantization and may deserve explicit preservation beyond Preserve-First-N heuristics.

cloudtainer_test: Synthetic dormant-token task: credentials/config values hidden behind anchors; compare attention-mass, recency, learned gates, and anchor-sponsorship retention.

title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning with Trigonometric KV Compression
claim: Trigonometric KV compression is proposed as a way to keep multi-turn long-reasoning sessions within memory budget.
cloudtainer_test: Approximate trigonometric/key projection compression on synthetic retrieval and compare phase/position preservation against scalar quantization and random projections.

title: Explicit Multi-head Attention for Interpretable and Efficient Transformer Reasoning
claim: More explicit inter-head structure can support KV-cache compression while preserving knowledge-intensive reasoning.
cloudtainer_test: Train single/multi-head tiny models; prune/share heads by explicit roles; measure whether role-separable heads compress better.

title: MrRoPE: Mixed-radix Rotary Position Embedding
claim: Mixed-radix views of RoPE may unify and improve training-free long-context extension methods.
cloudtainer_test: Add RoPE/CoPE/MrRoPE-style encodings to short-train/long-test associative recall and bracket matching tasks.

claim: C-RASP programs can be synthesized and verified, giving a formal surrogate lane for tiny transformer algorithm extraction.
cloudtainer_test: Pair trained tiny models with hand/synthesized RASP-like programs and use equivalence tests as stricter success criteria than validation accuracy.

claim: Weight decay may act as a scalar control parameter for memorization/generalization/collapse regimes; cheap attention diagnostics may predict grokking transitions.

title: Learned KV-Cache Eviction with Latent Memory for Long-Context Inference
claim: Evicted tokens can be compressed into a lightweight online latent memory that compensates for lost attention contributions.

claim: A small fraction of value states have abnormally large magnitudes, and evicting them can cause catastrophic repetitive reasoning loops; stochasticity increases cache diversity.

claim: A sliding-window L1 cache can feed evicted KV pairs into a fixed-size outer-product L2 memory, then fuse exact local attention with associative recall.

claim: For entmax attention, exact zeros turn sparse decoding into support recovery rather than softmax-tail approximation.
cloudtainer_test: Build softmax-vs-sparsemax/entmax support probes where success depends on recovering the exact support under page budgets.

claim: Fixed-point attractor refinement can make looped computation adaptive and stable; reported tiny-reasoning gains make it interesting for small CPU experiments.

title: Latent Chain-of-Thought Improves Structured-Data Transformers
claim: Feedback tokens and recurrent latent computation can improve time-series and tabular transformers, suggesting test-time compute is not only for text.

title: Weights to Code: Extracting Interpretable Algorithms from Discrete Transformers
claim: Discrete Transformer weights can sometimes be compiled into concise closed-form algorithmic expressions; representation entanglement is a key obstacle.

claim: Transformer+CoT can learn robust finite-state state tracking under skip-step/noise/length tests.
cloudtainer_test: Train tiny models on regular-language/state-machine tasks and extract state clusters; compare explicit scratchpad, compressed loop, and cache memory.

title: Diffusion Beats Autoregressive in Data-Constrained Settings
claim: Masked diffusion language models may outperform autoregressive models when data is constrained.

claim: Discrete diffusion language modeling families can be systematically compared beyond masked diffusion alone.

claim: Learned eviction policies can optimize retention beyond static attention or recency heuristics.

claim: Formalizes limited-space transformer/KV-cache compression as streaming attention approximation and tightens space-complexity bounds via coresets, polynomial methods, and partitioning.

claim: Proposes phase-transition framing for delayed generalization and reports modular-arithmetic grokking runs with weight-norm peaks preceding generalization.
cloudtainer_test: Use a tiny modular arithmetic battery to log norm peaks, accuracy kinks, and seed convergence as a cheap phase-transition sanity check.

title: Low-Rank Key Value Attention
claim: Shares a full-rank KV projection across heads plus low-rank head-specific residuals, aiming to preserve head diversity while reducing cache.
cloudtainer_test: Head-diversity toy: sweep low-rank residual rank on multi-relation associative recall; measure when shared KV loses separable head functions.

title: Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling
claim: Condenses context inside MLA-like latent space using query-aware pooling for semantics and anchor selection for positions, jointly reducing compute and cache.
cloudtainer_test: Latent pooling vs anchor-selection toy on associative recall with positional decoys; test whether semantic pooling preserves values while anchor selection preserves order.

title: eOptShrinkQ: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression Through Optimal Spectral Denoising and Quantization
claim: Frames KV cache as low-rank shared context plus residual; spectral denoising before quantization can improve inner-product fidelity and retrieval behavior.
cloudtainer_test: Add spiked-random-matrix cache generator to KV wind tunnel; compare scalar quantization before/after low-rank denoise and residual quantization.

title: UniPinRec: Unifying Generative Retrieval and Ranking at Pinterest Scale
claim: Production recommender unifies retrieval/ranking and reuses user-history transformer computation through cross-stage KV cache sharing.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny two-stage sequence ranking task where retrieval and reranking share a prefix encoder/cache; measure when cache sharing beats two independent models.

title: HalfNet: Randomized Neural Networks with Learned Subspace Geometry
claim: Learns low-rank geometry of a random weight distribution instead of all weights, suggesting predictive power can live in subspace geometry rather than exact parameters.
cloudtainer_test: Random-feature toy with learned covariance rank; compare against fully learned small MLPs on synthetic algorithmic tasks.

title: Patch-Effect Graph Kernels for LLM Interpretability
claim: Represents activation-patching effects as graphs over model components and uses graph features/kernels to compare circuit structures across tasks.
cloudtainer_test: For tiny trained models, store intervention effects as graphs and cluster tasks/seeds by graph structure; ask whether circuits become visible earlier than accuracy.

title: MechRL: Reinforcement Learning Agents Perform Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability
claim: Casts circuit discovery as RL over ablation actions and reports transfer across tasks in GPT-2-small-style attention-head action spaces.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny circuit-discovery gridworld: RL or bandit agent chooses heads/neurons to ablate on induction and associative-recall tasks; compare to greedy and random ablation.

title: Depth-Attention: Cross-Layer Value Mixing for Language Models
claim: Adds cross-layer value mixing so a layer can read and combine value information from earlier layers rather than trusting only the final/current representation.
cloudtainer_test: Simulate depth stacks where the best signal appears at mid-depth or is corrupted late; compare final-only, residual averaging, and query-conditioned depth mixing.

title: Dynamic Linear Attention
claim: Argues fixed state merging in multi-state linear attention loses critical tokens and accumulates error, and proposes dynamic memory modeling.
cloudtainer_test: Synthetic non-stationary sequences with transitions; compare fixed block summaries, recency-biased summaries, random merging, and drift-aware dynamic merging under equal state budgets.

title: Do Value Vectors in Deep Layers Need Context from the Residual Stream?
claim: Bank of Values replaces deeper-layer residual-derived value vectors with token-specific lookup vectors in later layers, claiming improved validation loss and reduced value cache/compute in tested scales.
cloudtainer_test: Synthetic identity-vs-context attention probe: compare context-dependent values, static token value banks, and hybrids as residual/context noise grows.

title: Blurry Window Attention
claim: Blurry Window Attention stores a frequency window and reconstructs a blurry KV history via Dirichlet-kernel interpolation, reporting better state efficiency than sliding-window attention on MQAR.
cloudtainer_test: Frequency-memory toy: smooth history plus sharp old spikes; compare exact recent window, exponential decay, Fourier/blurry reconstruction, and hybrid exact-recent plus blurry-old.

title: Rethinking LoRA Memory Through the Lens of KV Cache Compression
claim: Document-specific LoRA appears most useful when context-side evidence in KV cache is aggressively compressed; the adapter acts as decoding-time parametric memory.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny key-value QA world: train low-rank adapter-like memory vectors over documents; sweep retained cache fraction and measure when parameter memory dominates.

title: ART: Attention Run-time Termination for Efficient Large Language Model Decoding
claim: ART stops traversing additional KV blocks during attention once accumulated output magnitude/direction is stable, improving throughput without changing retention policy.
cloudtainer_test: Blockwise attention accumulator: measure read fraction vs output error under front-loaded, tail-surprise, diffuse, and late-direction-flip synthetic caches.

title: RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention
claim: RedKnot decomposes cache utility across KV heads, arguing that heads have different roles, ranges, and runtime importance rather than one homogeneous token cache.
cloudtainer_test: Multi-head synthetic cache zoo: assign heads to local, global, anchor, and distractor roles; test static vs learned per-head budgets.

title: Multi-Segment Attention: Enabling Efficient KV-Cache Management for Faster LLM Serving
claim: AsymCache/MSA treats lossless evicted-cache reconstruction as a latency-aware scheduling problem, not just hit-rate maximization.
cloudtainer_test: Toy noncontiguous cache scheduling: assign reconstruction costs and attention kernel penalties to segments; optimize latency/error frontier.

title: SpectrumKV: Per-Token Mixed-Precision KV Cache Transfer for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
claim: SpectrumKV sends important tokens at higher precision and lower-importance tokens at INT8/INT4, noting that INT4 tolerance can be model-dependent.
cloudtainer_test: Extend KV wind tunnel with per-token bit allocation: sinks/outliers at high precision, medium tokens int8, tail int4; compare to uniform quantization.

title: End-to-End Context Compression at Scale
claim: Latent Context Language Models encode raw inputs into fewer continuous embeddings, avoiding full prefill and providing an alternative to post-hoc KV eviction.
cloudtainer_test: Soft-token compressor toy: learn a small encoder to compress synthetic documents before query; compare to KV eviction and Tensor Cache at equal token budget.

title: Leyline: KV Cache Directives for Agentic Inference
claim: Agentic workloads edit trajectories; Leyline introduces serving-side directives for splicing/removing/replacing cached spans rather than assuming append-only cache growth.
cloudtainer_test: Editable-cache algebra toy: simulate span splice, semantic forgetting, and RoPE-like position correction over synthetic key-value histories.

title: SparseX: Efficient Segment-Level KV Cache Sharing for Interleaved LLM Serving
claim: SparseX reuses repeated non-prefix segments across requests/turns and selectively recomputes sparse correction tokens to restore contextual interactions.
cloudtainer_test: Segment reuse toy: move repeated chunks to new contexts and test which boundary/correction tokens repair attention outputs.

title: Adaptive Memory Decay for Log-Linear Attention
claim: Learns per-token, per-level decay in log-linear/Fenwick memory so decay adapts to content rather than position alone.
cloudtainer_test: Fenwick-memory simulator: compare fixed decay, learned oracle decay, and small MLP decay on selective copy and associative recall.

title: Thin Keys, Full Values: Reducing KV Cache via Low-Dimensional Attention Selection
claim: Selection may need fewer dimensions than value transfer; factor keys while keeping full values to reduce key-cache footprint.
cloudtainer_test: Random projection/SVD key compression toy: degrade key dimension and measure nearest-support errors vs value-transfer accuracy.

title: HySparse: A Hybrid Sparse Attention Architecture with Oracle Token Selection and KV Cache Sharing
claim: Uses preceding full-attention layers as an oracle for sparse layer token selection while allowing sparse layers to reuse full-layer KV cache.
cloudtainer_test: Layer oracle toy: compare full-layer-derived selection vs local sparse proxies in multi-layer synthetic retrieval.

title: FadeMem: Distance-Aware Memory Consolidation for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
claim: Organizes historical KV blocks into dense-near/sparse-far temporal hierarchy under a fixed budget, motivated by fine details decaying faster than coarse scene/identity.
cloudtainer_test: Hierarchical cache toy: coarse/mid/fine stream with old anchors; compare sliding window, first+recent, uniform blocks, FadeMem-like power bins, and oracle anchors.

title: Cartridges at Scale: Training Modular KV Caches over Large Document Collections
claim: Trains modular reusable KV caches over large document collections; dynamic distractor mixing and a budget manager make multi-cartridge composition work where naive isolated mixing collapses.
cloudtainer_test: Toy cartridge routing: train small per-document memory vectors over synthetic fact collections, mix distractors, and test whether routing/budgeting beats monolithic compressed memory.

title: KV-Fold: One-Step KV-Cache Recurrence for Long-Context Inference
claim: Treats KV cache as an accumulator in a left fold over chunks; reports stable drift plateaus and exact needle retrieval across deep chunk chains without retraining.
cloudtainer_test: Frozen tiny model or tensor recurrence: repeatedly concatenate compressed chunk state and measure drift, retrieval, and saturation vs chunk depth.

title: Training Transformers for KV Cache Compressibility
claim: Argues KV compressibility is a learned representation property; KV-CAT masks KV slots during training to encourage representations that compress better after training.
cloudtainer_test: C++ compressibility proxy: compare base isotropic vs KV-CAT-like clustered representations under uniform, prototype, and needle-aware compression.

title: AHA-WAM: Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
claim: Separates low-frequency world planning with rolling KV memory from high-frequency action execution that queries reusable latent context.
cloudtainer_test: Synthetic control toy: slow hidden world state plus fast action loop; compare synchronous full update, low-frequency memory, and query-routed context.

title: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
claim: Treats tree-search inference cache as active branches plus ancestors; inactive subtrees are recoverable through tree-aware eviction and lazy rehydration.
cloudtainer_test: Branching reasoning toy: tree frontier with revisits; compare flat LRU/recency eviction against ancestor-aware cache allocation and lazy restore.

title: Intra-request branch orchestration for efficient LLM reasoning
claim: Uses lightweight probes over layer activations to decide whether reasoning branches should terminate, duplicate, or continue.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny branch policy simulator: branches have noisy correctness features; test early-stop/duplicate/continue policies under compute budgets.

title: Alignment Collapse Under KV Cache Quantization: Diagnosis and Mitigation
claim: Flags that KV quantization may shift alignment or safety behavior, not just average task accuracy; needs independent confirmation.
cloudtainer_test: C++ safety-subspace quantization probe: compare mean reconstruction against low-dimensional safety projection flips, p99 safety error, and per-channel/protected-channel mitigations.

title: More Tokens, Lower Precision: Towards the Optimal Token-Precision Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
claim: Argues that under fixed budget, retaining more tokens at lower precision can outperform retaining fewer tokens at higher precision, especially for retrieval-heavy long context.
cloudtainer_test: Now has a runnable equal-byte token-vs-precision frontier probe: fewer 8-bit tokens vs more 2/4-bit tokens vs mixed precision and sponsor policies.

title: Understanding the Physics of Key-Value Cache Compression
claim: Frames cache compression collapse as a structural phase transition where sparse token routes survive until consensus/global eviction destroys routing flexibility.
cloudtainer_test: Route-lottery simulator: create multiple sparse evidence paths and test whether consensus eviction collapses route diversity before average error warns us.

title: ReasonAlloc: Hierarchical Decoding-Time KV Cache Budget Allocation for Reasoning Models
claim: Decoding-time cache compression should not use uniform layer/head budgets; distilled reasoning models exhibit a non-monotone architecture-specific Reasoning Wave plus online head heterogeneity.
cloudtainer_test: Runnable toy added: synthetic layer/head/time demand landscapes comparing uniform, pyramid, static wave, online head, and oracle allocation.

title: Attention Amnesia in Hybrid LLMs: When CoT Fine-Tuning Breaks Long-Range Recall, and How to Fix It
claim: CoT SFT can damage long-context recall in hybrid linear-attention models by biasing Q/K routing toward short-range patterns; restoring pre-SFT W_Q/W_K can recover retrieval.
cloudtainer_test: Runnable toy added: old semantic target vs recent local decoy; compare post-local-biased routing, QK restore, and compromise.

title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
claim: A separate neural memory indexer predicts future query-critical KV chunks and keeps only those loaded, reporting large physical KV cache reductions on long-context suites.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: train/query-free dual-encoder style indexer on generated future-query demands; compare reactive eviction vs lookahead chunk retention.

title: You Only Index Once: Cross-Layer Sparse Attention with Shared Routing
claim: Share token-level sparse-attention routing indices across layers in KV-sharing architectures to amortize top-k routing overhead.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: compare per-layer top-k indexes vs one shared index when layer demands agree, partially agree, or conflict.

title: Sparse Attention as a Range Searching Problem: Towards an Inference-Efficient Index for KV Cache
claim: Reframes sparse attention as halfspace/range searching with zero-false-negative retrieval guarantees for keys above a threshold.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: Louver-like cone/range index on synthetic K/Q distributions; measure false negatives, false positives, and output error.

title: Echo-Infinity: Learning Evolving Memory for Real-Time Infinite Video Generation
claim: Uses learnable Memory Queries updated when frames leave the local window, compressing any-length history at constant cost.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: memory-query consolidation on synthetic streams; compare learned/gated summary slots vs fixed exponential summaries.

title: Trace Only What You Need: Structure-Aware On-Demand Hypergraph Memory for Long-Document Question Answering
claim: DocTrace builds document-structure-aware and experience-guided hypergraph working memory on demand, reducing cost while improving long-doc QA.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: generate hierarchical documents with cross-evidence answers; compare flat retrieval, tree traversal, and hyperedge working memory.

title: Density Field State Space Models: 1-Bit Distillation, Efficient Inference, and Knowledge Organization in Mamba-2
claim: Compresses SSMs to a 1-bit scaffold with int8 low-rank correction, framing knowledge as density-field organization.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: binarized recurrent state-space associative recall with low-rank correction; compare memory capacity vs bit budget.

title: Multi-Head Low-Rank Attention
claim: Preserves low-rank latent KV compression while making latent states partitionable across tensor-parallel shards.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: latent rank partitioning vs head specialization in small attention modules.

title: Task Structure Reverses Layerwise State Encoding in Sequence Models
claim: Shows task structure can reverse where state information is represented across layers in sequence models.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: train tiny models on alternate state-tracking tasks and map layerwise linear-probe state recovery.

title: Learning State-Tracking from Code Using Linear RNNs
claim: Converts permutation/state tracking into REPL-like code traces and finds linear RNNs can excel where Transformers struggle.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: code-trace state tracking task for Transformer vs linear RNN vs recurrent memory cell.

title: When Do Attention Circuits Form? Developmental Trajectories of Capability and Attention-Sink Emergence Across Three 1B-Class Architectures
claim: Tracks induction, previous-token, and BOS-attractor head formation over checkpoints; claims circuit transitions can be separated from attention-sink emergence.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: save checkpoints during tiny induction training and compute participation-ratio/sink/capability screens.

title: Momentum Attention: The Physics of In-Context Learning and Spectral Forensics for Mechanistic Interpretability
claim: Adds a momentum/high-pass query-key component and claims single-layer induction and spectral diagnostics.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: one-layer induction task with/without momentum term; inspect frequency bands and induction accuracy.

title: Optimal Post-Training Quantization Scales and Where to Find Them
claim: Focuses on choosing better post-training quantization scales, directly relevant to KV/activation scale-error probes.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: plug learned or searched scales into KV Wind Tunnel and compare against minmax/row/varnorm scales.

title: Express Language Modeling
claim: A new language-modeling/inference direction from the June 2026 feed; potentially relevant to efficient next-token objectives.
cloudtainer_test: Scout only: read before building; possible relation to nonstandard decoding or compact distribution models.

title: K-Forcing: Joint Next-K-Token Decoding via Push-Forward Language Modeling
claim: Joint next-K-token decoding reframes multi-token inference; likely useful for cheap toy comparisons against speculative decoding.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: train a tiny push-forward predictor on algorithmic sequences and compare wall-clock/accuracy to one-step AR.

title: CLP: Collocation-Length Prediction for Zero-Loss Adaptive Multi-Token Inference
claim: Predicts when multiple tokens can be safely emitted together without loss; relevant to confidence/termination probes.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: predict safe run length in deterministic synthetic languages; combine with ART-style runtime termination.

title: What Fits (Into Few Tokens) Does Not Overfit: Compression and Generalization in ML Research Agents
claim: Suggests severe compression can improve generalization in agentic research settings; relevant as a conceptual counterpoint to cache compression.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: compress generated task descriptions into small latent/token summaries and test out-of-distribution plan reuse.

title: Recoverable but Not Stationary: Local Linear Structures in Weights and Activations
claim: Local linear structures in weights/activations may be recoverable but not stationary; relevant to lightweight probes and low-rank adapters.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: track local linear probes across training checkpoints and input regimes; test stationarity assumptions for cache indexes.

title: Reasoning-Aware KV Cache Sharing and Confident Early Stopping
claim: Training-free branch reasoning framework sharing KV caches across semantically similar branches and stopping confident branches early.
cloudtainer_test: Existing branch-cache-sharing probe can be extended with early-stop confidence thresholds and adversarial branch masquerades.

title: Reservoir Attention Network: Fixed Random Reservoir State for Transformers
claim: Injects a fixed random reservoir into a transformer to carry state between forward passes without retraining the backbone.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: fixed echo-state reservoir attached to tiny attention model; evaluate cross-call memory without KV cache.

title: Parallel Causal Associative Fields: Gated Sparse Memory for Long-Context Language Modeling
claim: Writes local causal successor records into hash buckets, retrieves bounded candidates, and gates sparse cache output with a local model to avoid fixed recurrent bottlenecks.
cloudtainer_test: Runnable PCAF sparse-memory probe: hash retrieval vs full attention, local window, semantic top-k oracle, and recency tie-breaks on old successor facts and collision traps.

title: IntentKV: Cross-Turn Intent-Aware KV Cache Pruning for Agent Inference
claim: Maintains session-level QueryMemory and prunes long agent trajectories by current/cross-turn intent while preserving prefix-cache composability through slot redirection.
cloudtainer_test: Runnable IntentKV toy: stable intent, intent shift, buried tool result, and adversarial recent-noise sessions under fixed KV budgets.

title: Rethinking the Role of Positional Encoding: Sliding-Window Transformers without PE Remain Turing Complete
claim: Finite sliding-window autoregression itself breaks permutation symmetry; HIST updates can reveal the token that left the window even without explicit positional encodings.
cloudtainer_test: Runnable HIST window probe: infer outgoing token from histogram_before + incoming + histogram_after; compare exact delta, noisy delta, and static histogram baselines.

title: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows
claim: Models continuous thought positions with a normalizing-flow head inside a causal stream, preserving sampling/scoring/likelihood and KV-cache compatibility.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: flow-latent vs deterministic latent vs explicit step routing with cost/accuracy and exploration proxies.

title: Geometric Latent Reasoning Induces Shorter Generations in LLMs
claim: Argues structure of intermediate continuous states matters for replacing early explicit reasoning with latent computation.
cloudtainer_test: Synthetic latent-state geometry: manifold mismatch vs generation cost; test simple geometric priors.

title: Unlocking the Black Box of Latent Reasoning: An Interpretability-Guided Approach to Intervention
claim: Uses structural, causal, and geometric probes to analyze latent reasoning vectors and intervene at decode time.
cloudtainer_test: Probe latent-step vectors in toy models; test whether early latent states are causal hubs and whether geometric clean-up helps.

title: Closing the Loop on Latent Reasoning via Test-Time Reconstruction
claim: Frames latent reasoning states as objects that need verification/reconstruction instead of being blindly passed forward.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: after latent update, reconstruct task state or next explicit token; use reconstruction error as a halting/correction signal.

title: TARPO: Token-Wise Latent-Explicit Reasoning via Action-Routing Policy Optimization
claim: Learns a token-wise router that chooses discrete token generation or continuous latent reasoning under a joint RL objective.
cloudtainer_test: Runnable latent-router toy: explicit/latent/flow-latent modes, cost penalties, catastrophic latent mismatch, and oracle/entropy/mismatch routers.

title: Low-Rank Decay for Grokking in Scale-Invariant Transformers: A Spectral-Geometric View
claim: Suggests spectral/nuclear-norm-like low-rank decay can keep reshaping normalized transformer weights after L2 radial decay stops being useful, accelerating grokking.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny modular arithmetic training with L2 vs low-rank decay; track Q/K rank collapse and generalization delay.

title: Grokking as Structural Inference: Transformers Need Bayesian Lottery Tickets
claim: Separates MLP capacity from attention structural inference; delayed generalization occurs when informative tokens lack enough attention mass.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny sequence task where attention support can be structurally intervened; compare grokking time with and without KL support hints.

title: Extreme Low-Bit Inference in Reasoning Models
claim: Evaluates W4A4 / low-precision KV regimes for reasoning models with long reasoning budgets.
cloudtainer_test: Extend token-precision frontier with activation/weight/KV precision axes and reasoning-length sensitivity.

title: WhiFlash: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Token-Level Cross-Paradigm Routing
claim: Routes speculative decoding token by token between autoregressive and diffusion/parallel drafting paradigms because drafting accuracy fluctuates within sequences.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: per-state draft method selector on deterministic/structured languages; measure accepted tokens vs router mistakes.

title: BUdget-Driven DYnamic Depth Routing for Adaptive Large Language Model Inference
claim: Dynamic depth routing under explicit budgets; related to early exit and depth-as-compute allocation.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: allocate layer/depth budget across easy/hard tokens; connect to Reasoning Wave and ART termination probes.

title: A Unified Framework for Latent Communication in LLM Agents
claim: Unifies latent chain-of-thought and latent communication between agents through hidden-state/KV-cache-like messages.
cloudtainer_test: Toy: two agents exchange compressed hidden messages vs text messages on synthetic coordination tasks; detect information leakage and mismatch.

title: SparDA: Sparse Decoupled Attention for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
claim: Adds a Forecast projection to predict next-layer KV blocks, decoupling sparse selection from the current query and enabling lookahead prefetch/offload.
cloudtainer_test: Forecast sparse routing toy: compare forecast_next_layer, same-query, shared-once, previous-layer reuse, and oracle support under drift/noise regimes.

title: Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving
claim: Non-uniform cache compression can preserve information but creates fragmentation/scheduling/kernel-utilization problems; static head profiles and grouped pages can make it practical.
cloudtainer_test: Head-profile stability toy: are head retention patterns stable enough that deterministic budgets beat dynamic per-request routing under synthetic multi-turn mixes?

title: ActiveMem: Distributed Active Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning
claim: Decouples planner reasoning from a distributed memory system that accumulates/consolidates semantic gists, reducing central-context overload.
cloudtainer_test: Two-process toy: planner sees only compact gists while background memory consolidates details; compare central full-history, pruning, and distributed-gist memory.

title: Learning What to Remember: Observability-Safe Memory Retention via Constrained Optimization for Long-Horizon Language Agents
claim: Memory retention should be a constrained stochastic optimization with budget feasibility, evidence utility, delayed miss costs, reacquisition delays, stale risk, and a strict separation between online-observable features and offline supervision.
cloudtainer_test: Runnable delayed-cost retention toy: online policies choose memories under budget; hidden evaluation reveals future utility, stale penalties, reacquisition cost, and redundancy.

title: One Token per Multimodal Evidence: Latent Memory for Resource-Constrained QA
claim: Compresses each evidence item to one latent token trained for reconstruction, retrieval, and generation, reducing generator token consumption on QA.
cloudtainer_test: Latent evidence toy: one vector per fact/document, compare retrieval-only, reconstruction-gated, and raw evidence expansion under fixed token budget.

title: Infini Memory: Maintainable Topic Documents for Long-Term LLM Agent Memory
claim: Treats long-term agent memory as maintainable topic-structured documents with staged observations, consolidation, metadata, and iterative evidence inspection.
cloudtainer_test: C++ topic-doc memory probe: streaming facts with revisions and corrections; compare flat records, topic documents, temporal graph memory, and non-destructive graph memory.

title: HIPIF: Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Learning
claim: Organizes long-horizon agent execution around explicit subgoals and folds completed subgoal histories to reduce long-context interference.
cloudtainer_test: Subgoal folding toy: generated tool trajectories with completed subgoals; test when folding beats full history, recency, and flat summary.

title: Less Context, Better Agents: Efficient Context Engineering for Long-Horizon Tool-Using LLM Agents
claim: In an enterprise tool-use benchmark, pruning to recent tool calls plus automated summarization outperformed full conversation history while reducing token use/runtime.
cloudtainer_test: Tool-trajectory toy: simulate stale tool outputs and verbose observations; compare full history, last-k, summarization, and selective memory under exact-state scoring.

title: Gated Bidirectional Linear Attention for Generative Retrieval
claim: Extends kernelized linear attention to bidirectional encoders with local causal mixing, key gating, and gated RMSNorm, targeting long history retrieval.
cloudtainer_test: Non-causal recall toy: compare softmax bidirectional attention, linear attention, gated linear attention, and hybrid SA/linear blocks on long history retrieval.

title: Thinking Deeper, Not Longer: Depth-Recurrent Transformers for Compositional Generalization
claim: Shared-weight depth recurrence with silent-thinking objective, LayerScale, and identity-biased recurrence creates a compute-step frontier for graph/logic/text compositional tasks.
cloudtainer_test: Vertical-CoT tiny arena: sweep recurrence steps vs task depth; compare explicit scratchpad tokens, fixed-depth transformer, and shared recurrent block.

title: Context-Folding: Scaling Long-Horizon LLM Agent via Context-Folding
claim: Agents can branch into token-intensive sub-trajectories and fold them back into concise summaries to manage finite working context.
cloudtainer_test: Branch/fold trajectory toy: exact simulator where subtasks emit long evidence logs; score state preservation after folding vs full-history and naïve summary.

title: Memory Retention Is Not Enough to Master Memory Tasks: Memory Rewriting Diagnostics
claim: Continual memory tasks require rewriting outdated instructions, not merely retaining old cues; diagnostic tasks include sequences where new cues invalidate old ones.
cloudtainer_test: Overwrite trap: streaming key updates where old facts become harmful; compare cache eviction, stale-averse retention, and explicit rewrite memory.

title: EASE-TTT: Evidence-Aligned Selective Test-Time Training for Long-Context Question Answering
claim: Retrieved evidence chunks can supervise query-side attention adaptation instead of replacing the full context; small decoder models improve on LongBench QA in the paper setting.
cloudtainer_test: Toy query-vector update: convert retrieval hits into a soft target and measure evidence mass/answer accuracy against retrieval-only and random adaptation.

title: Still: Amortized KV Cache Compaction in a Single Forward Pass
claim: A small Perceiver-style module with latent queries can compact each layer KV cache in one forward pass without query-specific optimization at inference.
cloudtainer_test: Single-pass latent-slot compactor toy: compare latent slots, centroids, top-k, and hybrid slots on clustered topics and isolated needles.

title: Semantic Cache Distillation: Efficient State Transfer via Reuse and Selective Patching
claim: KV/cache state reuse breaks when producer and consumer weights differ; selective patching can adapt state across shared-architecture but weight-mismatched models.
cloudtainer_test: Cross-model patch toy: rotate/distort a latent state, reuse it in a consumer, and learn minimal patch vectors only for high-error semantic regions.

title: Planning-aligned Token Compression for Long-Context Autonomous Driving
claim: Compression quality should be judged by downstream planning relevance, not only reconstruction or retrieval scores.
cloudtainer_test: Planning-token toy: retain scene tokens under equal budget and score whether the retained set preserves action choice, not text similarity.

title: A Pre-Training Analogue of Grokking in Language Models: Tracing Delayed Grammatical Generalization
claim: Delayed generalization can be studied during LM pretraining by splitting examples by exposure of critical phrases rather than classic train/test labels.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny grammar exposure split: train a small LM on synthetic minimal pairs and track delayed generalization after critical phrase exposure.

title: From Rigid to Dynamic: Entropy-Guided Adaptive Inference for Long-Context LLMs
claim: Attention heads may be rigid or dynamic in a context-dependent way; entropy can guide per-head/segment budgets, and decode tokens can help identify latent critical cache entries.
cloudtainer_test: Synthetic multi-head cache budget probe: compare uniform, offline head type, entropy-adaptive, decode-conditioned entropy, and oracle policies under rigid/dynamic/trap regimes.

title: Agentic Transformers Provably Learn to Search via Reinforcement Learning
claim: A two-head transformer can implement randomized DFS in a stochastic tree: one head tracks actions and another detects failure/backtracking; policy-gradient curriculum can discover it.
cloudtainer_test: Stochastic tree-search environment with action-trace/failure-trace ablations, DFS/ranked DFS policies, then later tiny policy-gradient transformer.

title: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
claim: GUI/VLM cache utility can specialize by attention subspace and drift over interaction time; fixed top-B fused saliency is too rigid.
cloudtainer_test: Synthetic visual-grid/cache trajectory: spatial subspace role migration, temporal redundancy discount, entropy-temperature scoring, and late UI-token importance traps.

title: Exact Linear Attention
claim: Kernel choices might provide exact linear attention while constraining gradients and token dilution; claims include interpretable memory-lobe style modules.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny kernel lab: compare softmax attention, feature-map linear attention, exact-kernel variants, and dilution/stability metrics on associative recall.

title: FlashCP: Load-Balanced Communication-Efficient Context Parallelism for LLM Training
claim: Long-context training sharding can waste communication through redundant KV movement; document-aware sharding is a systems-side cousin of cache/object structure.
cloudtainer_test: Not a direct CPU toy; keep as a systems analogy for whole-document vs per-document segmentation in synthetic cache reuse experiments.

title: KV Cache Offloading for Context-Intensive Tasks
claim: Context-intensive extraction benchmarks expose failures in KV offloading/compression that are hidden by tasks requiring only sparse lookup.
cloudtainer_test: Build a tiny Text2JSON-like extraction stressor where many facts must survive compression, not just a single needle.

title: Can LLMs Beat Classical Hyperparameter Optimization Algorithms? A Study on autoresearch
claim: Classical HPO methods beat pure LLM agents in fixed search spaces; code-editing narrows but does not close the gap; Centaur shares CMA-ES state with an LLM and performs best in their experiments.
cloudtainer_test: Toy HPO/autoresearch benchmark with OOM cliffs: random/TPE/CMA-ish/stateless-domain-prior vs Centaur-style state+domain hybrid.

title: EEVEE: Towards Test-time Prompt Learning in the Real World for Self-Improving Agents
claim: Multi-dataset test-time prompt learning uses a router that partitions heterogeneous task streams and co-evolves router and prompt configurations.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny router-prompt coevolution toy: nonstationary task stream where one prompt per cluster must adapt without cross-cluster interference.

title: Predicting Future Behaviors in Reasoning Models Enables Better Steering
claim: Future-behavior probes can predict likely downstream reasoning behavior from intermediate steps; steering via candidate sentence selection can preserve quality better than direct activation steering.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny future-failure probe: predict whether a partial search/reasoning trace will backtrack, loop, hallucinate, or succeed; use probe to choose next trace expansion.

title: TRACE: A Unified Rollout Budget Allocation Framework for Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning
claim: TRACE allocates rollout budget to prompt roots and intermediate prefixes likely to yield mixed terminal rewards, improving reward contrast under fixed rollout budgets.
cloudtainer_test: Synthetic tree rollout allocation: uniform vs root-level vs prefix-contrast vs oracle allocation on sparse terminal rewards.

title: A Unifying Lens on Supervised Fine-Tuning Through Target Distribution Design
claim: SFT can be reframed as token-level target distribution design; Target-SFT chooses how much probability to put on observed tokens versus alternatives.
cloudtainer_test: Toy ambiguous-demonstration SFT: one-hot targets vs softened target distributions on noisy algorithmic traces.

title: When to Align, When to Predict: A Phase Diagram for Multimodal Learning
claim: A linear phase diagram can predict when cross-modal alignment, cross-modal prediction, both, or neither should work under signal/noise/nuisance regimes.
cloudtainer_test: Methodology import: build phase diagrams for cache/memory probes before training; diagnose when a compression role should be beneficial or harmful.

title: The Residual Stream Is All You Need: On the Redundancy of the KV Cache in Transformer Inference
claim: KV tensors are deterministic from residual states; KV-Direct stores residual checkpoints and recomputes K/V to reduce memory while preserving outputs in their tests.
cloudtainer_test: Native residual-vs-KV object cost probe: exact projection sanity plus byte/time frontier for full KV, residual checkpoints, and lossy sliding window.

title: Move the Query, Not the Cache: Characterizing Cross-Instance Latent and Sparse Attention Redistribution Across GPU Fabrics
claim: For sparse/latent attention over remote chunks, moving a small query row can be cheaper than moving selected KV cache blocks; the route/fetch predicate depends on fabric and payload sizes.
cloudtainer_test: Native cross-instance cost model: move query vs move cache vs local recompute across block counts, batch sizes, fabrics, and latent/KV payload sizes.

title: AURA: Action-Gated Memory for Robot Policies at Constant VRAM
claim: In endless batch-1 embodied episodes, unbounded KV cache is the wrong memory; action surprise can gate writes to a constant-size state.
cloudtainer_test: Action-surprise write gate toy: only write memory when predicted action would change, compare to periodic/random/every-step writes under sparse recall/control traces.

title: Multi-Segment Attention: Enabling Efficient KV-Cache Management for Faster Large Language Model Serving
claim: AsymCache treats lossless cache residency as a latency optimization problem, with non-contiguous multi-segment attention and position/recompute-aware eviction.
cloudtainer_test: Block-residency scheduler toy: optimize hit rate plus recompute/attention-kernel cost instead of hit rate alone.

title: Entropy Gate: Entropy Quenching for Near-Lossless Token Compression in LLM Pipelines
claim: Compressing redundant prompt/output tokens before activation/cache machinery can compose with cache compression; tokens get energy/survival scores.
cloudtainer_test: Token-quench adversarial stream: remove low-energy repeated tokens, but red-team rare low-frequency anchors and later dependencies.

title: Exact Linear Attention
claim: Proposes exact kernel decompositions for linear-complexity attention plus constraints aimed at avoiding dilution/explosion.
cloudtainer_test: Kernel support toy: compare exact decomposable kernels on associative recall, dilution, and adversarial near-neighbor retrieval.

title: Beyond Tokens: A Unified Framework for Latent Communication in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
claim: Latent communication can move embeddings, hidden states, or KV caches; information richness, transport cost, and architecture-dependence form an ordering.
cloudtainer_test: Latent object taxonomy audit: classify CloudtainerML probes by WHAT/WHICH/HOW so cache/object experiments do not blur together.

title: Can LLMs Beat Classical Hyperparameter Optimization Algorithms? A Study on autoresearch
claim: Classical HPO beats pure LLM agents in fixed spaces, but Centaur improves by sharing CMA-ES state with an LLM; reliability/OOM avoidance matters strongly.
cloudtainer_test: Centaur-style state-sharing optimizer for choosing CloudtainerML sweep configs: classical state plus domain-prior overrides.

title: Vortex: Efficient and Programmable Sparse Attention Serving for AI Agents
claim: Sparse attention ideas need programmable serving substrates; Vortex provides a Python-embedded sparse attention frontend plus backend to iterate algorithms quickly.
cloudtainer_test: Make a tiny sparse-attention policy DSL/catalog so C++ probes can share routing policies instead of ad hoc loops.

title: Stochastic Sparse Attention for Memory-Bound Inference
claim: SANTA samples post-softmax value rows to form an unbiased value aggregation estimator, reducing value-cache reads in memory-bound decoding.
cloudtainer_test: C++ estimator wind tunnel: compare post-softmax Monte Carlo, stratified sampling, top-k, and value-aware sampling under rare high-value tails.

title: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management
claim: Long-horizon session history can be modeled as a typed knowledge graph and serialized into compact resume blocks, preserving rationale/structure better than flat text baselines.
cloudtainer_test: Graph memory toy for agent traces: preserve decisions, files, task transitions, and failure fixes under fixed token budget.

title: Forget, Then Recall: Learnable Compression and Selective Unfolding via Gist Sparse Attention
claim: Interleaved gist tokens can summarize chunks and route sparse attention to raw chunks that need selective unfolding; recursive gist-of-gist gives multi-resolution context access.
cloudtainer_test: Coarse-to-fine router toy: gist summaries choose raw chunks; adversarial isolated needles test whether unfolding recovers detail.

title: Observation, Not Prediction: Conversation-Level Disaggregated Scheduling for Agentic Serving
claim: Scheduling at conversation level can replace turn-level predictions with observable first-turn prefill and decoder KV occupancy, reducing time-to-first-effective-token and energy in their system.
cloudtainer_test: Conversation-level cost toy: decide prefill/decode placement from observable prefix/occupancy rather than predicted tail length.

title: HybridKV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model Inference
claim: Different attention heads may need distinct compression strategies; HybridKV classifies static/dynamic heads and combines text-prior pruning with chunk retrieval.
cloudtainer_test: Head-type classifier toy: static text-prior heads versus dynamic chunk-retrieval heads under visual/text-token imbalance.

title: Training-Free Native Sparse Attention for KV Cache Compression
claim: Hierarchical block-wise selection can adapt native sparse-attention insights to training-free KV compression.
cloudtainer_test: Block hierarchy probe: compare token top-k, flat block top-k, and hierarchical block selection on region-wipeout traps.

title: Recalling Too Well: Sycophancy Evaluation and Mitigation in Memory-Augmented Models
claim: Persistent memory can amplify sycophancy when extraction stores user misconceptions while dropping corrective context; the authors report much higher sycophancy rates than in-context baselines and propose lightweight mitigations.
cloudtainer_test: Symbolic memory red-team: compare belief snippets, recency memory, provenance-balanced memory, skeptical high-stakes memory, no-memory, and oracle memory.

title: Pushing the Limits of LLM Tool Calling via Experiential Knowledge Integration and Activation
claim: KATE finds instance-level experiential knowledge gives strong tool-use gains, width-expanded reasoning activates it better than deeper reasoning, and knowledge-aware RL improves internalization.
cloudtainer_test: Agent toy: memory bank of concrete tool episodes versus abstract intents; compare depth expansion, width sampling, and aggregation under tool-call traps.

title: Unifying Local Communications and Local Updates for LLM Pretraining
claim: GASLoC generalizes communication acceleration to outer optimizers with gossip-based training, local optimizer steps, and sparse randomized peer communication under heterogeneous bandwidth.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny distributed optimizer simulator: stale local updates plus sparse gossip over toy loss surfaces; test convergence versus all-reduce and DiLoCo-like averaging.

title: Periodic KV Cache Consolidation for Generalised Reasoning
claim: Bottlenecked Transformer uses a cache processor to periodically rewrite KV entries at reasoning-step boundaries, preserving/boosting math reasoning under bottlenecked cache.
cloudtainer_test: Step-boundary rewrite toy: compare continuous eviction, newline/step-boundary consolidation, and learned merge on multi-hop traces.

title: VeriCache: Turning Lossy KV Cache into Lossless LLM Inference
claim: Lossy KV compression can diverge over long decoding, especially in code and tool calling; verification/recovery can convert lossy cache behavior into lossless-equivalent generation in risky cases.
cloudtainer_test: Verifier guard wind tunnel: simulate long decode drift, critical tool-call sites, and selective recompute triggered by margin/drift/risk signals.

title: Tensor Memory: Fixed-Size Recurrent State for Long-Horizon Transformers
claim: Augments transformer blocks with a fixed-size recurrent 3D memory tensor using differentiable soft writes, local interaction, gated recurrent dynamics, and continuous reads.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny spatial-memory probe: hidden moving objects/facts are written to a fixed grid; compare flat KV retention, tensor memory, and recency windows.

title: CSR: Infinite-Horizon Real-Time Policies with Massive Cached State Representations
claim: For real-time embodied policies, prefix stability, incremental extensibility, and asynchronous state reconciliation enable long cached state with bounded latency spikes.
cloudtainer_test: CSR/ASR scheduler toy: state prefix stability plus asynchronous eviction/reconciliation under latency-spike constraints.

title: Gated Memory Policy
claim: Learns when to recall historical context and what to recall; long history can hurt Markovian tasks via distribution shift and overfitting.
cloudtainer_test: History-gate toy: mix Markovian and non-Markovian episodes; test if learned/gated recall beats always-history and no-history baselines.

title: Reasoning Cache: Continual Improvement Over Long Horizons via Short-Horizon RL
claim: Replaces standard autoregressive decoding with an iterative response-plus-summary cache that can improve over horizons longer than training budgets.
cloudtainer_test: Iterative summarize/refine toy: response statement plus summary state over many turns; compare plain chain, compressed summary, and learned update.

title: KV Cache Optimization Strategies for Scalable and Efficient LLM Inference
claim: Survey organizes KV optimization into eviction, compression/reconstruction, hybrid memory, new attention mechanisms, and combinations; no single technique dominates all settings.
cloudtainer_test: Use as taxonomy pressure: every CloudtainerML cache probe should declare which bucket and what adversarial regime it targets.

title: How Does Reasoning Flow? Tracing Attention-Induced Information Flow for Targeted RL in LLMs
claim: Token-level credit should follow answer-targeted information flow through an attention-induced DAG rather than uniform or pointwise heuristics.
cloudtainer_test: C++ FlowTrace toy: generate reasoning DAGs with true bridge tokens and decoys; compare uniform, recency, local attention mass, max-path, answer-targeted flow, and oracle credit.

title: Hasse Diagrams for Attention: A Partial Order Framework for Designing Transformer Masks
claim: Attention-mask information flow can be formalized as a partial-order/Hasse diagram, enabling constructive task-mask design and training-inference consistency analysis.
cloudtainer_test: C++ mask frontier toy: define required and forbidden reachability for task families; score mask policies on coverage, leakage, redundancy, and train-infer gap.

title: REAL: A Reasoning-Enhanced Graph Framework for Long-Term Memory Management of LLMs
claim: Long-term memory should preserve temporal validity, confidence, parallel fact versions, and exploration intent, with retrieval as guided subgraph search instead of flat recall.
cloudtainer_test: Extend topic-graph memory probe with valid intervals, confidence, non-destructive revisions, and query-intent beam search under missing evidence.

title: From Confident Closing to Silent Failure: Characterizing False Success in LLM Agents
claim: Agents can claim completion while environment state shows failure; lightweight detectors can outperform LLM judges for this failure mode.
cloudtainer_test: Symbolic agent trajectory probe: generate true/false completion states with confident closing text; compare judge-like surface heuristics, TF-IDF-style detectors, and environment-state verifiers.

title: T1-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Scenario Agents in Real-World Domains
claim: Agent benchmarks need multi-domain, multi-turn scenarios with sustained reasoning and coordination rather than isolated tasks.
cloudtainer_test: Tiny multi-domain agent stressor: interleaved customer-service domains with memory, state verification, task switching, and false-success traps.

title: Lightweight Latent Reasoning for Narrative Tasks
claim: Continuous latent tokens can substitute for some explicit reasoning tokens, reducing reasoning length while preserving task performance in narrative tasks.
cloudtainer_test: Latent/discrete router toy: train or simulate when projector-like latent steps should replace visible reasoning tokens under retrieval-heavy tasks.

title: Does Reasoning Preserve Alignment? On the Trustworthiness of Large Reasoning Models
claim: Reasoning post-training can improve reasoning benchmarks while regressing trustworthiness dimensions such as safety, toxicity, bias, privacy, and robustness.
cloudtainer_test: Alignment-regression toy: pair a reasoning-improvement objective with safety/privacy canaries and measure tradeoff/frontier under synthetic post-training updates.
